title: Turbocharger Operation and Components — 2.3L EcoBoost (231kW/314PS)
introduction:
I picture the turbocharger as exhaust lending the intake a hand. Exhaust turns a turbine wheel connected by a shaft to a compressor wheel, which pressurizes incoming air so the engine can take in a greater mass of air. That is a mechanical handoff: exhaust does not mix directly into the fresh-air passage.

For this EcoBoost application, the detailed operating explanation and component descriptions are referred to the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual. This page provides that route, without supplying a hardware layout, boost test or repair procedure.
